summary: LTP mode on NSE cash: the login, the register, a last-trade packet as an LTP frame; after the unregister a late packet reaches no one.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.

deviations.reason: The web's LTP dict carries the day volume from the last-trade packet (motilal_adapter.py _normalize_ltp_data); the desktop's LTP frame carries no volume for any broker: a carrier gap for lane wire (audit RB 'Verified broker fields dropped by the common carrier').
